newsitem.title: USA: Ceridian to redeem preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Ceridian to redeem preferred shares.

text.p: Ceridian Corp said Wednesday it has called for redemption on December 31, 1996 all of its outstanding 5-1/2 percent cumulative convertible exchangeable preferred stock.

It will also redeem the related depositary shares, which each represent a one one-hundredth interest in a share of the preferred stock. There are 4.72 million depositary shares currently outstanding, Ceridian said.

The redemption price for each depositary share is $51.10 plus accrued and unpaid dividends from October 1 to December 31. The result is a total of $51.7875 payable on December 31 for each depositary share.

As an alternative, Ceridian said holders have the option of converting their depositary shares into shares of Ceridian common stock at a rate of 2.2 shares of common stock. The conversion right expires at the close of business on December 23, 1996.
The final dividend on the depositary shares will be paid on December 31 to holders of record on December 6.
Ceridian is an information services and defense electronics company.
